independent_Whisper_text_only.text: Good evening, everybody. Today, we are pleased to have invited Maggie Schwartz from Harvard University to tell us her feeling of studying together with her mom. Well, Maggie. Thanks. I am very happy to meet you.

items.decision: 纸源数字解析与B1教材均印Maggie Shorts；原音同一姓名位置模型转Schwartz。保留有纸源依据的专名拼写，仅绑定该真实整词声段，不据模型另造人名。

items.source_sentence_en: Is the phenomenon of parent and kids studying together at university a rare case?

source_refs.file: 2016专八笔试真题和答案/2016年TEM8真题答案.pdf
B1专八历年真题+听力+解析/01.历年真题+解析/2016年专八真题+音频+解析/2016年英语专八真题解析.pdf

independent_Whisper_text_only.text: I see. Is the phenomenon of parent and kids studying together at university a rare case? I am afraid not. Changing careers later in life is no longer a rarity, so it is not uncommon for students and their parents to be toying with the big decisions at the same time.

items.decision: 纸源kids，独立Whisper1121—1146也读kids；主/局部Parakeet读kid。保留有纸源及独立模型依据的复数，不将kid/kids加入全局等价表；此处只共用真实完整词段。
